players.bio: Aké Arnaud Loba (born 1 April 1998) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Liga MX club Querétaro, on loan from Tijuana.

Alí Ávila Vega ( Ahome , Sinaloa , Mexico , September 23, 2003) is a Mexican soccer player of Lebanese origin. He plays as a forward and is currently with Club Universidad Nacional of the Mexican First Division . On loan from Club de Fútbol Monterrey .
Brayton Josué Vázquez Vélez (born 5 March 1998) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back.

Diego Antonio Reyes Rosales (born 19 September 1992) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Querétaro. He is an Olympic gold medalist. Reyes made his professional debut with Club América, where he spent three years before moving overseas.
Erik Dueñas is an American professional soccer player currently playing as a midfielder for Querétaro in Liga MX.

Franco Matías Russo (born 25 October 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Liga MX team Querétaro, on loan from Bulgarian First League club Ludogorets Razgrad.

Iker Benito Sánchez (born 10 August 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for CA Osasuna. Mainly a right winger, he can also play as a right-back. Born in Miranda de Ebro, Burgos, Castile and León, Benito joined CA Osasuna's youth setup in 2018, after a period on trial at Athletic Bilbao, from CD Pamplona.

Lucas Nicolás Abascia (born 10 December 1995) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a centre-back for Central Córdoba SdE, on loan from Chilean club Ñublense. Club career Born in Rosario, Argentina, Abascia was with both Bancario and Rosario Central as a youth player. At professional level, he started his career with Tiro Federal in the 2016 Torneo Federal B.

Paulo Victor de Almeida Barbosa (born 13 April 2001), known as Paulo Victor, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as left back for Portuguese club Farense. Club career Born in Bocaiúva, Minas Gerais but raised in Piabetá, Magé, Rio de Janeiro, Paulo Victor was a Nova Iguaçu youth graduate.
Santiago Damián Homenchenko Bianchi (born 30 August 2003) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or centre-back for Liga MX club Querétaro, on loan from Pachuca.

Víctor Daniel López Sámano (born 8 May 2003), also known by the nickname Chespi, is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Liga MX club Querétaro, on loan from Monterrey and the Mexico national under-23 team.
